headlines.title_en: Meta releases its first frontier model, Muse Wonder

headlines.title_zh: 微軟新 AI 晶片 Maia 300 降低對輝達 GPU 的依賴
headlines.title_en: Microsoft's new AI chip makes it less reliant on Nvidia's GPUs

headlines.title_zh: 微軟總裁：英國最適合主導 AI 監管
headlines.title_en: Microsoft president says UK is best placed to drive AI regulation

headlines.title_zh: WindBorne 以氣象氣球數據拿下美國空軍大單
headlines.title_en: WindBorne wins a hefty US Air Force contract for its balloon data

headlines.title_zh: 前 Plaud 高層為背景聆聽 AI 應用募得 2600 萬美元
headlines.title_en: Former Plaud exec raises $26M for AI app that listens to you in the background

script: 今天是 2026 年 10 月 13 日，歡迎收聽 AI 科技新聞。首先來看 Meta。Meta 正式推出旗下第一款前沿模型 Muse Wonder，以及 Muse Wonder Full。先前推出的 Muse Spark 主打輕量、低延遲，而這次的 Wonder 系列規模更大，據稱能力更強，在基準測試上分數更高，處理程式設計等複雜任務的表現也更好。Meta 表示，新模型足以和業界頂尖模型一較高下，顯示它正急起直追，想在 AI 競賽中把失去的時間追回來。接著是微軟。微軟發表第三代自研 AI 晶片 Maia 300，定位為微軟產品與服務的主要 AI 推論系統。這款晶片不只提升雲端執行 AI 工作的成本效益與效率，也更能應付最新的推理模型和代理型任務，讓微軟降低對輝達 GPU 的依賴。同樣來自微軟，總裁布萊德史密斯呼籲盡快推動 AI 監管。他直言，牛奶和洗衣機受到的監管，都比 AI 公司還多，並認為英國最有條件帶頭推動 AI 監管。再來看國防應用。矽谷新創 WindBorne 運用氣象氣球結合 AI 預測天氣，日前拿下美國空軍一份價值將近五千萬美元的合約。最後是新創募資消息。一位前 Plaud 高層，為一款會在背景持續聆聽使用者的 AI 應用程式募得兩千六百萬美元。這類產品的理念是，AI 越了解使用者的情境，就越能提供合適的協助與建議，但也再次引發外界對持續錄音與隱私的關注。以上就是今天的 AI 科技新聞，感謝您的收聽，我們明天見。

headlines.title_en: Former Plaud exec raises $26M for AI app that listens to you in the background

script: Today is October 13, 2026, and this is AI Tech News. Meta has released its first frontier models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full. Unlike the lightweight, low latency Muse Spark, the Wonder models are larger and said to be more capable, with higher benchmark scores and better results on complex tasks like coding. Meta claims they can go toe to toe with the industry's best. Microsoft announced Maia 300, its third generation in-house AI chip, designed to be the primary AI inference system for its products and services. It improves cost and efficiency in the cloud, handles the latest reasoning models and agentic tasks, and reduces reliance on Nvidia GPUs. Also from Microsoft, president Brad Smith called for urgent AI regulation, saying milk and washing machines face more oversight than AI companies, and argued the UK is best placed to drive it. Weather startup WindBorne, which uses balloons and AI to predict the weather, won a US Air Force contract worth almost 50 million dollars. Finally, a former Plaud executive raised 26 million dollars for an AI app that listens in the background to gather context and assist users. That's AI Tech News for today. Thanks for listening.

script: 今天是2026年10月13日，歡迎收聽國際新聞。首先來看黑海情勢。保加利亞總理表示，兩艘商船在保加利亞外海遭到無人機攻擊，其中一艘沉沒，另一艘烏克蘭船東的船隻也受損。他懷疑攻擊是俄羅斯所為，已經召見俄羅斯大使。中東方面，葉門胡塞武裝攻擊沙烏地首都利雅德的國際機場和另一處設施，造成13人死亡，局勢明顯升級。沙烏地部長誓言將做出嚴正回應。受到安全警告影響，利雅德一場亞冠聯賽足球賽也延後一小時開踢，C羅仍在比賽中進球。接著是烏克蘭。總統澤倫斯基說，自從美國總統川普宣布能源基礎設施不會成為攻擊目標以來，俄羅斯已經攻擊了六處烏克蘭能源設施。另外，烏克蘭前總司令瑟爾斯基在去職後首度受訪，他告訴英國廣播公司，俄羅斯的進攻能力已經瓦解。再來看印度。數千名民眾遊行到最高法院，要求選舉首長因修訂選民名冊而下台。先前首都新德里度過混亂的週末，數千名示威者遭警方拘留。所謂蟑螂運動的領袖，也在翻越路障進入禁止進入的抗議地點後被拘留。此外，兩天內至少有35名媒體工作者在採訪抗議時遭到拘留。最後是美國。移民執法人員搜索了眾議員伊爾汗奧瑪的住家。奧瑪一向強烈批評川普，她表示這次搜索是在針對政敵，並強調自己不會被噤聲。以上是今天的國際新聞，感謝您的收聽。

script: Today is October 13, 2026, and this is International News. Bulgaria's prime minister says two merchant ships were hit by drones off the Black Sea coast, with one sinking. He suspects Russia was behind the attacks and has summoned the Russian ambassador. In the Gulf, Saudi Arabia has vowed a serious response after Houthi attacks hit Riyadh's international airport and another facility, killing 13 people in a significant escalation. A football match in Riyadh was delayed an hour over security warnings. In Ukraine, President Zelensky says Russia has struck six energy sites since President Trump announced energy infrastructure would not be targeted. Separately, Ukraine's former top general, Syrskyi, told the BBC that Russia's offensive ability is broken. In India, thousands marched to the Supreme Court demanding the election chief resign over revised voter lists, after a chaotic weekend in Delhi when thousands were detained. Leaders of the so-called cockroach movement were also detained, and at least 35 journalists were held while covering the protests. And in the United States, immigration agents searched the home of congresswoman Ilhan Omar. Omar, an outspoken Trump critic, called it an attempt to target political enemies and said she will not be silenced. That's International News for today.
